\section{\texttt{build\_llm}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.factory.build_llm}\index{Functions!build\_llm}

Construct the LLM provider selected by \texttt{FEEDBACK\_\allowbreak{}AGENT\_\allowbreak{}LLM\_\allowbreak{}PROVIDER}.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
build_llm(settings: Settings) -> LLMProvider
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{LLMProvider}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{ValueError}
\apifield{Details}\texttt{local} (the default) needs no API key and stays fully deterministic. \texttt{openai} targets any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint (\texttt{OPENAI\_\allowbreak{}BASE\_\allowbreak{}URL}), \texttt{openai\_\allowbreak{}responses} targets OpenAI's Responses API, \texttt{anthropic} uses the official SDK (optional \texttt{anthropic} extra), \texttt{bedrock} uses AWS Bedrock Runtime (optional \texttt{bedrock} extra), and \texttt{ollama} talks to a local Ollama server. Missing credentials raise a clear configuration error at construction time.
